problem_statement.text: Pores and craters were found in the e-coat of low-temperature radiator brackets, with some craters down to bare metal. The craters are round, Ø 0.3–1.0 mm, and located along the MIG seam on the rear face and within ± 5 mm of it.

rows.text: Pores and craters in the e-coat of low-temperature radiator brackets (part AR-1009). Craters are round, Ø 0.3–1.0 mm, some down to bare metal. E-coat thickness at crater rim is 4–8 µm, while flat areas are 19–23 µm (requirement 18–25 µm).
rows.label: What

rows.text: Detected at OEM Norte cooling module line and paint lab. Craters are located along the MIG seam on the rear face and within ± 5 mm of it.
rows.label: Where

rows.text: The lot L26250-AR1009-01 was produced on 2026-09-07 (morning shift). Parts were shipped on 2026-09-13 and 2026-09-16. The defect was detected on 2026-09-22 during incoming audit, and the complaint was issued on 2026-09-23.
rows.label: When

rows.text: The defect was detected by OEM Norte. Customer contact is M. Ruiz, Supplier Quality Engineer (+34 948 000 312, m.ruiz@oem-norte.example).
rows.label: Who

rows.text: Part number AR-1009 (low-temperature radiator bracket), from lot L26250-AR1009-01. Delivery notes AL-26-00562 and AL-26-00563 are affected.
rows.label: Which

rows.text: The defect was detected visually during an incoming audit and confirmed by paint lab observation. EDX at crater centre detected Si, Mn and O (glassy residue). Adhesion on flat areas is Gt 0 (conform).

rows.text: Clips de sujeción del tubo de freno (AR-1012) con una fuerza de retención de 31–43 N, inferior al requisito de ≥ 45 N.
rows.label: Qué

rows.text: Detectado en la inspección de recepción del cliente Ribera Chassis Systems y en el stock del cliente. El lote fue fabricado en la prensa PR-250.
rows.label: Dónde

rows.text: El lote L26236-AR1012-03 fue fabricado el 24/08/2026 en el turno de noche. Los albaranes AL-26-00527 y AL-26-00528 fueron expedidos el 28/08/2026 y el 01/09/2026. La detección ocurrió el 15/09/2026 y la reclamación fue emitida el 16/09/2026.
rows.label: Cuándo

rows.text: Detectado por el personal de inspección de recepción de Ribera Chassis Systems. El contacto del cliente es C. Jiménez del departamento de Calidad de Proveedores.
rows.label: Quién

rows.text: Pieza AR-1012 (Clip de sujeción del tubo de freno), lote L26236-AR1012-03, entregado con los albaranes AL-26-00527 y AL-26-00528.
rows.label: Cuál

rows.text: El problema se manifestó en el ensayo de extracción del tubo, donde 3 de 5 clips iniciales no alcanzaron la fuerza de retención mínima. Posteriormente, 12 de 20 clips ensayados mostraron valores de 31–43 N.
rows.label: Cómo

rows.text: Se bloquearon y seleccionaron 500 clips NOK. En el ensayo de laboratorio, 12 de 20 clips mostraron valores no conformes.
rows.label: Cuántos

similar.discriminating_evidence: La reclamación actual indica que el ángulo de la lengüeta es conforme (89,6–90,4°), lo que contradice la causa raíz del 8D anterior (ángulo de 86–87°).

hypotheses.title: La baja dureza del material de la bobina S-ULTZ-260209 causó la baja fuerza de retención del clip AR-1012.
hypotheses.rationale: Los clips NOK del lote L26236-AR1012-03 tienen una dureza HV1 de 402–418 HV1, por debajo del requisito de 440–520 HV1. Los clips de referencia conformes tienen una dureza de 462–471 HV1. Esto sugiere que la baja dureza del material es la causa de la baja fuerza de retención, ya que la lengüeta cede sin deformación visible del ángulo.
hypotheses.fmea_gap: No hay AMFE de AR-1012 en el repositorio accesible: hipótesis fuera del AMFE; hueco a cerrar.

hypotheses.title: El AMFE de proceso para la pieza AR-1012 no contempla la dureza del material como una característica de control para la fuerza de retención.
hypotheses.rationale: No se dispone del AMFE de proceso para la pieza AR-1012. En el 8D anterior para una pieza similar (AR-1005), se confirmó que la recepción de acero se basaba solo en el certificado 3.1 sin ensayo propio para piezas con características críticas, lo que llevó a usar material en el límite de la especificación.
hypotheses.verification: Revisar el AMFE de proceso de la pieza AR-1012 para verificar si la dureza del material está considerada como una característica de control y si existen controles de detección adecuados.

rows.text: The defect was detected at the OEM Norte e-drive module line, specifically at station ED-4, during inverter fixing. The parts were manufactured in the weld cell CR-02.
rows.label: Where

rows.text: The lot L26252-AR1010-01 was produced on 2026-09-09 during the afternoon shift. The parts were shipped on 2026-09-14 (AL-26-00573) and 2026-09-16 (AL-26-00572). The defect was detected on 2026-09-22 and the complaint was issued on 2026-09-23.
rows.label: When

rows.text: The defect was detected by OEM Norte. The customer contact is M. Ruiz, Supplier Quality Engineer, phone +34 948 000 312, email m.ruiz@oem-norte.example.
rows.label: Who

rows.text: The affected part is the Power inverter bracket, part number AR-1010, drawing number ON-121455. The affected lot is L26252-AR1010-01, delivered with delivery notes AL-26-00572 and AL-26-00573.
rows.label: Which

rows.text: The defect manifested as the M8 weld nut spinning during tightening of the inverter fixing bolt to 25 Nm. It was detected by testing the torque-out of the weld nut (7 parts at 19–31 Nm, requirement ≥ 40 Nm) and the push-out force (2.1–2.9 kN, requirement ≥ 4.0 kN).
rows.label: How

rows.text: The suspect quantity delivered is 2,760 pieces.
rows.label: How many

hypotheses.title: The weld nut's Zn-Ni coating thickness was at the upper limit, leading to insufficient fusion during welding.
hypotheses.rationale: The customer's lab report indicates flattened but not fused projections and bright metallic residue on the nut face, consistent with insufficient fusion. A similar past issue (8D-ARGA-2025-008) for the same part AR-1010 identified that Zn-Ni coating at the upper tolerance combined with an unvalidated weld schedule caused low torque-out. The FMEA also considers this cause.

query.sql: SELECT code, name, customer_type, report_template, report_language, containment_hours, report_days FROM erp.customers WHERE code = %(code)s

SELECT l.lot_code, l.part_ref, l.order_id, l.production_date, l.shift, l.press, l.weld_cell, l.qty_produced, l.qty_scrap, l.status, l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code, p.description AS part_description, p.customer_code, p.routing, p.material AS part_material, p.thickness_mm, p.special_char, p.char_class, p.die, p.uses_weld_nut FROM erp.lots l JOIN erp.parts p ON p.ref = l.part_ref WHERE l.lot_code = %(lot_code)s

SELECT m.lot_code, m.supplier_code, m.material, m.received_date, m.qty, m.unit, m.certificate_ok, m.notes FROM erp.lots l JOIN erp.material_lots m ON m.lot_code IN (l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code) WHERE l.lot_code = %(lot_code)s

SELECT c.complaint_id, c.customer_code, c.part_ref, c.lot_code, c.received_date, c.defect, c.qty_affected, c.status, c.report_8d_id FROM erp.complaints c WHERE (%(part_ref)s::text IS NULL OR c.part_ref = %(part_ref)s) AND (%(customer_code)s::text IS NULL OR c.customer_code = %(customer_code)s) AND (%(from_date)s::date IS NULL OR c.received_date >= %(from_date)s) AND (%(status)s::text IS NULL OR c.status = %(status)s) ORDER BY c.received_date, c.complaint_id LIMIT 200

SELECT c.complaint_id, c.customer_code, c.part_ref, c.lot_code, c.received_date, c.defect, c.qty_affected, c.status, c.report_8d_id FROM erp.complaints c WHERE (%(part_ref)s::text IS NULL OR c.part_ref = %(part_ref)s) AND (%(customer_code)s::text IS NULL OR c.customer_code = %(customer_code)s) AND (%(from_date)s::date IS NULL OR c.received_date >= %(from_date)s) AND (%(status)s::text IS NULL OR c.status = %(status)s) ORDER BY c.received_date, c.complaint_id LIMIT 200

SELECT p.ref AS part_ref, p.customer_code, p.weld_cell, p.uses_weld_nut, p.press, p.die, count(*) AS lots, min(l.production_date) AS first_production_date, max(l.production_date) AS last_production_date FROM erp.lots l JOIN erp.parts p ON p.ref = l.part_ref WHERE %(material_lot_code)s IN (l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code) GROUP BY p.ref, p.customer_code, p.weld_cell, p.uses_weld_nut, p.press, p.die ORDER BY p.ref LIMIT 200

SELECT l.lot_code, l.part_ref, l.production_date, l.shift, l.weld_cell, l.qty_produced, l.qty_scrap, l.status FROM erp.lots l WHERE l.part_ref = ANY(%(part_refs)s) AND %(material_lot_code)s IN (l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code) ORDER BY l.part_ref, l.production_date, l.lot_code

SELECT s.shipment_id, s.lot_code, l.part_ref, s.customer_code, s.ship_date, s.qty FROM erp.lots l JOIN erp.shipments s ON s.lot_code = l.lot_code WHERE l.part_ref = ANY(%(part_refs)s) AND %(material_lot_code)s IN (l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code) ORDER BY l.part_ref, s.ship_date, s.shipment_id

SELECT l.lot_code, l.part_ref, l.order_id, l.production_date, l.shift, l.press, l.weld_cell, l.qty_produced, l.qty_scrap, l.status, l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code FROM erp.lots l WHERE l.part_ref = %(part_ref)s AND l.production_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND (%(wire_lot_code)s::text IS NULL OR l.wire_lot_code = %(wire_lot_code)s) AND (%(steel_lot_code)s::text IS NULL OR l.steel_lot_code = %(steel_lot_code)s) AND (%(weld_cell)s::text IS NULL OR l.weld_cell = %(weld_cell)s) AND (%(shift)s::text IS NULL OR l.shift = %(shift)s) AND (%(status)s::text IS NULL OR l.status = %(status)s) ORDER BY l.production_date, l.lot_code LIMIT 200

SELECT s.shipment_id, s.lot_code, l.part_ref, s.customer_code, s.ship_date, s.qty FROM erp.shipments s JOIN erp.lots l ON l.lot_code = s.lot_code WHERE (%(lot_code)s::text IS NULL OR s.lot_code = %(lot_code)s) AND (%(part_ref)s::text IS NULL OR l.part_ref = %(part_ref)s) AND (%(from_date)s::date IS NULL OR s.ship_date >= %(from_date)s) AND (%(to_date)s::date IS NULL OR s.ship_date <= %(to_date)s) ORDER BY s.ship_date, s.shipment_id LIMIT 200
